messages.body:
You are working on GitHub issue #81: "[P1][feature] Migrate channel error classes to core ChannelError"

## Issue Details
Three channels define their own error classes extending plain Error, while core already has ChannelError extends OmniError that none of them use:
- Core (core/src/errors.ts:155-177): ChannelError extends OmniError with channelType, instanceId, ErrorCode enum + recoverable flag
- Discord (channel-discord/src/utils/errors.ts:32): extends Error, local ErrorCode enum
- WhatsApp (channel-whatsapp/src/utils/errors.ts:27): extends Error, local ErrorCode enum
- Slack (channel-slack/src/types.ts:269): extends Error, retryable instead of recoverable
- Telegram: No custom error class at all

### Current State (partially done)
Core ChannelError exists but plugins still use their own error classes.

### Acceptance Criteria
- All 4 channels use ChannelError or subclass from @omni/core
- Local error code enums mapped to core ErrorCode
- retryable → recoverable standardized
- Telegram has proper error class
- make check green

## YOUR TASK
1. First run /council to analyze this issue — get architectural review and recommendations
2. Then run /wish to generate a structured wish plan file with scope, acceptance criteria, and execution groups
3. You are DONE when the wish file is written to disk
